decisions.decision: Committee members agreed they would like to see a range of scenarios for borrowing for future projects, to settle on a plan for municipal and school building projects the town can afford.
decisions.quote: committee members agreed they'd like to see a range of scenarios for borrowing for future projects in order to settle on a plan for municipal building projects

decisions.decision: Committee members agreed they have no desire to change the current fiscal policy regarding debt capacity.
decisions.quote: committee members also agreed that they have no desire to change the current fiscal policy regarding debt capacity.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three DPW purchases (a 6-wheel truck, a 10-wheel truck and a tractor mower) cost more than their capital appropriations, to be paid from the current year's operating budget.
budget_items.quote: the three purchases cost $1,140 over the capital appropriations, and funds will come from the current year's operating budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA will receive a per-elder amount from the FY23 Formula Grant fund, based on a population count.
budget_items.quote: the coa will receive $12 per elder in the fy23 formula grant fund.

budget_items.topic: ADA patio at the senior center
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 capital plan request for the ADA patio at the senior center was reported as insufficient to fund the project.
budget_items.quote: the $100,000 fy23 capital plan request for the ada patio at the senior center will not be enough money to fund the project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town's financial policy sets excludable debt at 11 percent, regular debt at 4 percent, and total allowable debt at 14 percent of the total tax levy.
budget_items.quote: the policy is written so excludable debt is 11 percent, while regular debt is 4 percent, but the total allowable debt is 14 percent of the total tax levy.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A committee member anticipates legal fees regarding the proposed 40B project; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: anticipates legal fees regarding the matter.

public_comment.speaker: Chris Menard
public_comment.quote: mr. menard commented that he watched the zba meeting/public hearing on the proposed 40b project, and anticipates legal fees regarding the matter.
